This small plot behind my house is only about a tenth of a hectare, so I manage it carefully with what we have at home. I grow this crop mostly for the family's needs, not for selling much, so I don't spend cash on chemical fertilizer for it — I spread manure from our cattle instead. I use seed I saved from last year, like my mother did, and my daughter and I do most of the weeding ourselves. It is close to the house so I can keep watch for pests without needing to spray.
